It objectively surveys employees' attitudes toward their work and draws up a plan based on the results. It picks up on anxieties and dissatisfactions, puts the company's reason for existing into words, reviews the code of conduct, creates credo cards bearing the philosophy and code of conduct, conveys them using video and other media at presentations such as kickoff meetings, and also carries out work such as renewing the corporate website.
